notes: A sparse amendment, and the first real-world proof that the rulebook design works. Moldova raised the VAT registration threshold twice inside one year: to MDL 1.5m from 1 January 2026, then to MDL 1.7m from 1 March 2026. Rather than duplicating the whole year, this set carries ONLY the key that changed and overlaps md-2026 for the rest of the year. Because it was published later, it shadows md-2026 for dates both cover; every other key falls through to md-2026. A product that hardcoded the threshold would have had to ship a patch mid-year — twice.

sources.act: Legea nr. 12/2026 pentru modificarea art. 112 din Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997
sources.article: art. I (Codul fiscal art. 112 alin. (1) și (4): „1,5 milioane” devine „1,7 milioane”); art. II: în vigoare la 1 martie 2026

tax.vat.registration_threshold.note: Raised from MDL 1,500,000 to MDL 1,700,000 with effect from 1 March 2026 by Law 12/2026. Secondary sources report an original proposal of MDL 3.2m and a phased path constrained by EU Directive 2006/112/EC (roughly EUR 85,000); neither is read in an act. Expect further increases, so never treat this number as settled.
